title: Fix update prompt, bundle the CLI, and celebrate finished goals

requirements.text: A build whose stamp is older than a file touched during it still leads to a restart offer or another build
The app runs genlock from inside its own bundle, so a user without npm never sees an npm command
requirements.check: manual: run app with no genlock on PATH; set up a project

requirements.text: A goal can be completed from the app, with the user's words recorded
requirements.check: driver: complete a goal in the panel; genlock goal show reports done

requirements.text: Completed goals stay listed with when they finished, in the app and the CLI
Completing a goal shows a full-screen celebration, whoever completed it, once per goal
requirements.check: driver: complete from CLI with app open; screenshot; restart shows no repeat

text: No launch of the app can end or strand a running session, including one that cannot find Claude Code
check: driver: open, launch without claude, launch normally; same host pid

evidence: root cause: plist real rounded GenlockBuiltAt to a multiple of 128 (1793993728 % 128 = 0). build now stores integer: plutil shows 1793995211, %128 != 0. test testABuildBeforeALateTouchIsStillOffered passes

build/Genlock.app run with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and no GENLOCK_APP_CLI: genlockTool=.../Contents/Resources/genlock/run/genlock, set up a fresh repo with --private, initialized=true, no error. env -i run of the shim prints goal list using bundled node

driver: complete in app -> celebrating 'Ship the billing page', completedGoals 2->3, genlock goal completed lists it with 'Marked complete in the Genlock app'; goal with open task refused naming T-MDQ8A, nothing shown. Button click itself not driven
genlock goal completed lists date, name, evidence newest first; tests/run.mjs completing-goals checks pass; driver completedGoals counts across projects; panel screenshot checked

driver: app completion and CLI completion both celebrate; frame (0,0,1344,840)==screen; relaunch shows []; finished while closed shows it on launch; reopened+refinished shows again; old goal at baseline not shown; party2.png viewed. Visible fade on a real screen not seen because the driver keeps it transparent

repro on old build: running 1->0, host killed, channels gone. fixed build: PATH without claude then normal launch, same host pid 99679, running proj; wiped sessions.json same host; endSession hosts []; claude appearing mid-run starts session; socket removed: probe 0, second run exit 1 after 5.1s, hosts still 1

answers.observed: isolated driver runs with a stub claude: host pid unchanged across launch without claude; celebration frame equals screen frame; plutil stamp exact
answers.cause: session loss reproduced before the fix and gone after, so measured. Popup's trigger, Claude's auto-update at 14:35:23-25, is inferred from file times. How the 07:57 host was orphaned is a hypothesis
answers.absence: no real Claude Code update was raced against a launch; a real user click on Complete goal and the real full-screen fade were not exercised
answers.assumption: my assumption: bundling a 110MB node so nobody installs anything; plain-terminal claude in a set-up project still needs genlock on PATH
answers.falsify: a running host pid changing or vanishing across any launch without ending it; a second host appearing for one channel
